leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement the two-pointer technique to traverse the height array
Construct a loop that calculates the area between two vertical lines
Manipulate pointer positions based on height comparisons
Initialize and update a variable to track the maximum water container area
Apply the area calculation formula using minimum height and width
Control loop termination when pointers converge
Integrate all components into a complete solution function
